name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
description: Financial benefit of ₹6,000 per year payable in three equal installments to all landholding farmer families across the country.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year directly transferred to the farmer's bank account in three equal installments of ₹2,000 every 4 months.

excluded_categories: Income tax payers in last assessment year

application_process: 1. Apply online via PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) or nearest CSC / Farmer Service Center. 2. Enter Aadhaar details and upload land records. 3. Verification by local Revenue / Agriculture Department. 4. Direct Benefit Transfer initiated.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
description: Provides adequate and timely credit to farmers for agricultural cultivation, post-harvest expenses, and allied activities at subsidized interest rates.
benefits: Short-term crop loan up to ₹3,00,000 at an effective interest rate of 4% per annum (with prompt repayment incentive). Covers cultivation, maintenance of farm assets, and domestic consumption needs.
application_process: 1. Visit nearest public sector, cooperative, or regional rural bank branch. 2. Submit KCC one-page application form with land/crop details. 3. Bank sanctions credit limit within 14 days and issues RuPay KCC card.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: Comprehensive risk insurance covering yield losses due to non-preventable natural risks from pre-sowing to post-harvest stages.
benefits: Maximum insurance coverage for food and oilseed crops at ultra-low premium rates: 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, and 5% for commercial/horticultural crops. Balance premium subsidized by Central and State Governments.
documents: Sowing Certificate issued by Gram Panchayat / Village Officer
application_process: 1. Register on the PMFBY portal (pmfby.gov.in) or via local bank branch/CSC within notification deadline. 2. Select crop season, district, and notify sown area. 3. Pay beneficiary share of premium.

name: Krishak Bandhu Scheme (West Bengal)
description: Flagship West Bengal state scheme providing assured financial assistance and term life insurance to all farmers and recorded bhagchasis.
benefits: Direct financial aid up to ₹10,000 per year (minimum ₹4,000 for 1 acre or less, pro-rata for larger holdings) paid in two installments during Kharif and Rabi seasons. Also provides ₹2,00,000 death benefit for farmer families.
application_process: 1. Collect application form from Assistant Director of Agriculture (ADA) block office or Duare Sarkar camps. 2. Attach Porcha and bank details. 3. Approval and DBT transfer to bank account.

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
description: Medium to long-term debt financing facility for investment in viable post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets.
benefits: Interest subvention of 3% per annum on loans up to ₹2 Crores for a maximum period of 7 years. Credit guarantee coverage under CGTMSE.
documents: Land ownership or long-term lease agreement for site
Bank balance sheet / past financial statements (if existing entity)
application_process: 1. Register on AIF Portal (agriinfra.dac.gov.in). 2. Submit online loan application with DPR. 3. Ministry appraisal and automated forwarding to chosen bank. 4. Sanction and interest subsidy activation.

name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
description: Increases agricultural productivity and reduces drudgery by providing subsidies for purchase of tractors, power tillers, rotavators, and implements.
benefits: 40% to 50% capital subsidy on purchase of approved agricultural machinery and implements. Up to 80% subsidy for setting up Custom Hiring Centers (CHCs).

excluded_categories: Farmers who availed tractor subsidy within last 5-7 years

documents: Valid Driving License (for tractor / power tiller)
application_process: 1. Register on agrimachinery.nic.in portal. 2. Select machinery manufacturer and dealer. 3. Block Agriculture Officer inspects and issues permit. 4. Purchase machine and receive direct DBT subsidy.

name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (Per Drop More Crop)
description: Promotes micro-irrigation systems (drip and sprinkler) to enhance water efficiency and reduce farming water costs.
benefits: Up to 55% subsidy for small and marginal farmers (45% for other farmers) for installation of drip and sprinkler irrigation equipment on farm lands.
documents: Water source availability certificate / Electricity bill of pump
Field map / layout of proposed micro-irrigation system
application_process: 1. Apply via State Agriculture / Horticulture Department portal. 2. Technical feasibility survey by empaneled irrigation agency. 3. Installation of drip/sprinkler kit. 4. Physical verification and release of subsidy.

name: NSFDC Micro Finance Scheme (MFS)
description: Direct micro-credit up to ₹1,40,000 for rural artisans, small shops, livestock rearing, and micro income-generating activities for SC beneficiaries.
benefits: Loan up to ₹1,40,000 at capped 6.5% per annum interest rate, with 36 months repayment tenure and 3 months moratorium.
documents: SC Caste Certificate issued by competent revenue authority
application_process: 1. Submit application through State Channelizing Agency (SCA) or empaneled rural banks. 2. SCA scrutiny and sanction. 3. Direct fund disbursement to applicant's bank account.

name: Mahila Samriddhi Yojana (MSY)
description: Exclusive micro-enterprise loan for rural women entrepreneurs to set up tailoring units, beauty parlors, handloom, and grocery stores.
benefits: Loan up to ₹1,40,000 per woman beneficiary at a highly subsidized interest rate of 4% per annum. Flexible repayment up to 36 months.
application_process: 1. Apply individually or via Self Help Group (SHG) to State Channelizing Agency (SCA). 2. Field verification by SCA field officer. 3. Fast-track sanction within 30 days.

name: Higher Education Loan Scheme (ELIS)
description: Concessional education loans for pursuing higher professional, technical, and engineering courses in India and abroad.
benefits: Loan up to ₹20,00,000 for courses in India and up to ₹30,00,000 for studies abroad. Interest rate of 4% per annum for male students and 3.5% per annum for female students.
application_process: 1. Apply online via NSFDC portal or State Channelizing Agency. 2. Provide admission letter and fee schedule. 3. Sanction and fee disbursement directly to educational institution.
